strings.name: Kailash Satyarthi
strings.role: Children’s rights activist · Nobel Peace laureate
strings.summary: After electrical-engineering training, Satyarthi turned to children’s rights, founding Bachpan Bachao Andolan in 1980 and working with colleagues on rescue, rehabilitation and education. Carpet certification and the Global March helped bring child protection into international policy. He shared the 2014 Nobel Peace Prize with Malala Yousafzai and later promoted youth and compassion initiatives. Institutional change reflected sustained collective work, not his efforts alone.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: He advanced campaigns against child labour and for children’s education, organized transnational public action and received the Nobel Peace Prize, influencing child-protection policy.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.highlights.h1.title: Child labour and education
strings.highlights.h1.text: Organizational rescue, education and transnational advocacy supported child protection; shared the 2014 Nobel with Malala.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Training in electrical and high-voltage engineering, followed by teaching.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Transnational public action
strings.highlights.h2.text: Helped develop Rugmark certification and the Global March, advancing supply-chain and labour-policy debate.
strings.timeline.t1.title: AI and compassion
strings.timeline.t1.text: Spoke at UC Berkeley, urging technology developers to consider human welfare.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Global compassion movement
strings.timeline.t2.text: Promoted compassion-guided public action and leadership.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Youth campaign
strings.timeline.t3.text: Launched 100 Million with young people and survivors of child exploitation.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Shared Nobel Peace Prize
strings.timeline.t4.text: Shared with Malala Yousafzai for opposing oppression of children and advancing education rights.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Global March Against Child Labour
strings.timeline.t5.text: Helped organize a transnational march promoting debate on the worst forms of child labour.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Rugmark launched
strings.timeline.t6.text: Helped establish child-labour-free carpet certification, later developed into GoodWeave.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founds Bachpan Bachao Andolan
strings.timeline.t7.text: Left engineering for child-labour abolition and education activism.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Vidisha
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born with surname Sharma, later trained in engineering.
